scope: Frozen inspected development set, single view30fps, unknown initial velocity; all1038 original cases13918 frames, same SAM3.1 tracks and decoded pixels
limits: Primary means/maxima are conditional on successful predictions; all failures retain original denominator and are reported alongside coverage. Common-success comparisons are supplementary and never replace full-scope failure reporting. Depth-lifting centres/metric loss differ from nonlinear projected outlines/pixel loss. Information supplied is matched; representations and optimisers are not identical. Background variants share physics groups. No independent generalisation or global-optimality claim.
metric_definition: Absolute relative gravity error in percent; means/maxima use successful fits, failures and threshold pass rates retain all 1038 cases. Coverage denotes successful inversion on this fixed development set, not whole-dataset eligibility.

inference_protocol.scope: Frozen accepted SAM3.1 development cases; six depth comparisons, no change to GravTrace
inference_protocol.observations: All original frame indices; same certified decoded BGR uint8 pixels converted exactly to RGB; same frozen integer SAM3.1 boxes. No redecoding, no frame or case removal.
inference_protocol.information: Same declared camera/K, initial window geometry and orientation, angular velocity/inertia/damping, mass/drag, gravity direction, fixed t0, velocity constraints and actual initial prompts. No reference velocity/target gravity in worker inputs; targets used only by separate scorer.
inference_protocol.neural_inputs: Five single-image models see each fitting frame individually (batching allowed). VGGT sees exactly all fitting frames of a window together, no additional frames. Initial prompt image and shared tracker prefix conditioning are disclosed in handoff but not queried for extra neural depth.
inference_protocol.depth_sampling: Original loader postprocess to original image size; median finite positive depth in central half of frozen box; at least 3x3 pixels. Invalid depth/frame errors remain full-case failures.
inference_protocol.lift_protocol: One scale anchored to declared initial surface distance; estimate zero-tau depth from all fitting depths using declared drag/time basis, not reference trajectory. Unknown Cartesian velocity, same speed 0-8 and elevation +-89 constraints, g 0.1-80; robust metric 3D displacement fit. Same declared fixed t0 including nonzero offsets; no velocity truth. Complete-frame requirement.
inference_protocol.limitations: Lifted centre rays and object surface depth are approximate representations of a rotating, partially visible object; metric 1m soft-L1 differs from pixel edge loss. Geometry/spin declarations are provided; the conventional lifting representation does not use full projected contours. VGGT predicts relative depth; others metric, all use identical declared scale anchor. Finite starts do not prove global optimality.
inference_protocol.report: All1038 denominator; failed/at_bound/invalid cases retained; event/gravity/camera/physics-group and common-success paired reports separate from full-method coverage; development evidence only.

scoring_protocol.scale_anchor: Declared initial surface depth; zero-tau surface depth inferred from all model depths using exact declared drag velocity/gravity time bases
scoring_protocol.fitter: Free 3D intercept, unknown velocity speed0-8 elevation+-89, g0.1-80. Exact drag translation basis. Metric soft-L1 scale1m; SLSQP ftol1e-12 maxiter500; LS plus fixed1,4,16,50 gravity starts; select metric loss only
scoring_protocol.observations: All original frame boxes and timestamps including declared fixed t0; no hidden-frame filtering. All depth values required. Missing/invalid/inference_error/at_bound included in original1038 denominator
scoring_protocol.spin: Same angular motion/geometry available in handoff, conventional lifted-box-centre representation does not model full rotating outlines. This difference is disclosed, not hidden as identical residuals.
scoring_protocol.targets: Target gravity exists only in separate scoring dictionary; no reference v0 in fitting inputs
scoring_protocol.scope: Inspected development data, not heldout generalisation or global optimality

physics_groups: 723 motion-fingerprint groups. Equal-weight macro means use groups with successful fits; their counts are reported. Full group-level research records remain local. Paired bootstrap uses 2000 resamples of common-success physical groups, fixed seed 20261011, and is descriptive development evidence.
